 Human Interest Things To Do in Detroit This Weekend: October 23-October 25
 Detroit’s weekend blends spooky science, star-studded performances, and plenty of local flavor. The Michigan Science Center gets delightfully creepy with After Dark: Weird Science, an adults-only night of eerie experiments…
 Jennifer Eggleston 
 Published Oct 22, 2026 1:16 PM EDT Getty Images Share this story Detroit's weekend blends spooky science, star-studded performances, and plenty of local flavor. The Michigan Science Center gets delightfully creepy with After Dark: Weird Science, an adults-only night of eerie experiments and myth-busting talks. Little Caesars Arena welcomes the Disney Worlds Collide Concert Tour, uniting "Descendants," "Zombies," and "Camp Rock" stars for a sing-along spectacle. Craft beer lovers can raise a glass at the 17th Annual Detroit Fall Beer Festival at Eastern Market, complete with live music and wrestling. Comedy, Broadway, classic rock, and a full week of events keep the fun going across the city. 
 After Dark: Weird Science 
 What: Eerie experiments and spooky science for grown-ups 
 When: Friday, Oct. 23, 2026, at 6 p.m. 
 Where: Michigan Science Center, 5020 John R. St., Detroit 
 Cost: Tickets start at $30 
 The Michigan Science Center explores science's odd and unsettling corners at  After Dark: Weird Science , an adults-only evening of eerie experiments and surprising discoveries. Wayne State University mortuary science professors separate fact from fiction about death and funeral services, while neurology students explain how fear works in the brain. In the Penske Planetarium, Sounds in Space imagines the cosmos's haunting noises. Demonstrations on forensic fingerprinting and bone degreasing run throughout the night, and guests can check out real human brains from THINK Lab and a display from the Anatomy of Death Museum. Costumes are encouraged, and the Huffman BBQ food truck will be on-site. 
 Disney Worlds Collide Concert Tour 
 What: Three Disney franchises collide on one stage 
 When: Friday, Oct. 23, 2026, at 7 p.m. 
 Where: Little Caesars Arena, 2645 Woodward Ave., Detroit 
 Cost: Tickets start at $63.55 
 The Disney Worlds Collide Concert Tour brings together the "Descendants," "Zombies," and "Camp Rock" franchises for one high-energy show. Stars including Malachi Barton, Liamani Segura, Dara Reneé, Mekonnen Knife, Hudson Stone, Swayam Bhatia, Kiara Romero, and Alexandro Byrd perform hits from all three film series, along with fresh mashups. Dynamic choreography and dazzling special effects keep the excitement building, and fans can dress as their favorite characters and sing along. With "Camp Rock" joining the tour for the first time, the production blends new favorites with plenty of nostalgia. 
 17th Annual Detroit Fall Beer Festival 
 What: Michigan craft beer takes over Eastern Market 
 When: Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026, from 1 p.m. to 6 p.m. 
 Where: Eastern Market, Shed 5, 2810 Russell St., Detroit 
 Cost: General admission $60 in advance, $70 day of; VIP $80 in advance, $90 day of 
 The Michigan Brewers Guild returns to Detroit's historic Eastern Market for the  17th Annual Detroit Fall Beer Festival , one of the state's largest celebrations of Michigan-made beer. Guests can sample fresh brews from top breweries across Michigan while enjoying live music from Theo Gridiron and Friends, Audrey Rey, and Konrad Lee, the self-styled lounge singer extraordinaire. International Bigtime Wrestling adds high-flying action with live matches in the parking lot. Food from local favorites, including Yellow Dog Craft BBQ and Señors Taco Truck, rounds out a lively afternoon as attendees toast the state's thriving craft beer scene. 
 Other Events 
 Detroit's weekend lineup spans comedy, Broadway, and classic rock. A headlining comedian brings his latest tour to a landmark downtown theater, while a Broadway legend shares the stage with the city's acclaimed orchestra for two performances. Hard rock fans can close out the weekend with a band that helped define the late-1980s sound. 
 Jo Koy: Koy Meets World Tour : Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026, at 8 p.m. at Fox Theatre Detroit, 2211 Woodward Ave., Detroit 
 Bernadette Peters Live in Concert : Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026, at 8 p.m.; Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026, at 3 p.m. at Orchestra Hall, 3711 Woodward Ave., Detroit 
 Winger : Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026, at 7:30 p.m. at Sound Board at MotorCity Casino Hotel, 2901 W. Grand River Ave., Detroit 
 More To Explore Next Week 
 Detroit's week ahead mixes live music, creative fun, and hometown hockey. A jazz cafe hosts a soulful tribute night, while a downtown studio pairs painting with a round of trivia. Indie music fans can catch a rising artist at a historic concert hall, and Red Wings fans can cheer on their team as it takes on an Original Six rival. 
 A Tribute to the Jute Joint Featuring The Gud Band : Monday, Oct. 26, 2026, from 7 p.m. to 10 p.m. at Aretha's Jazz Cafe, 350 Madison St., Detroit 
 Tuesday Trivia: Colors of the Wind : Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026, from 7 p.m. to 9 p.m. at Painting With a Twist, 1420 Washington Blvd., Detroit 
 Quadeca : Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026, at 7 p.m. at Saint Andrew's Hall, 431 E. Congress St., Detroit 
 Detroit Red Wings vs. Chicago Blackhawks : Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026, at 7:30 p.m. at Little Caesars Arena, 2645 Woodward Ave., Detroit
